title: Defenestrator
description: Claude subscription usage as sampled by the defenestrator (https://github.com/justmytwospence/defenestrator): account-wide 5-hour and 7-day utilization, window starts, caps, and a log of every decision it made and why. Data: the defenestrator_usage and defenestrator_event measurements in InfluxDB. Codex has its own board.

list.name: Started by defenestrator
list.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_event" and r._field == "reason" and r.provider == "claude" and r.kind == "ping")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: "Defenestrator started a window: " + r._value}))

panels.title: 5-hour utilization (last 2 days)
panels.description: Account-wide 5-hour usage. The dashed line is an even pace from 0% at the window start to 100% at its reset; the red band is where usage is above it, i.e. you are burning faster than the window allows.

panels.title: Windows started per day
panels.description: A new 5-hour window shows as a jump of about 5 hours in the reset time between samples. Counts windows however they started (a ping or your own use), so more windows a day is the point of the defenestrator.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"

option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Denver")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "claude" and r._field == "reset5")
  |> difference(nonNegative: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 600.0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: count, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if exists r._value then r._value else 0}))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "windows started"})
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      day = date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1d)
      names = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]
      return {r with day: names[date.weekDay(t: day)] + " " + string(v: date.month(t: day)) + "/" + string(v: date.monthDay(t: day))}
    })
  |> keep(columns: ["day", "windows started"])

panels.title: 5-hour: projected at reset
panels.description: Where this window ends up if usage continues at its rate over the last 90 minutes of the same window. 100 or more means you will hit the cap before it resets. Without a running window it shows the last value.

targets.query:
import "array"

now_s = float(v: int(v: now())) / 1000000000.0

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -90m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "claude" and (r._field == "u5" or r._field == "reset5"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.u5 and exists r.reset5 and r.reset5 > now_s)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(identity: {n: 0, u0: 0.0, t0: 0.0, u1: 0.0, t1: 0.0, reset: 0.0},
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({n: accumulator.n + 1,
                                      u0: if accumulator.n == 0 then r.u5 else accumulator.u0,
                                      t0: if accumulator.n == 0 then float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0 else accumulator.t0,
                                      u1: r.u5, t1: float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0, reset: r.reset5}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      slope = if r.t1 > r.t0 and r.u1 > r.u0 then (r.u1 - r.u0) / (r.t1 - r.t0) else 0.0
      return {_time: now(), _value: r.u1 + slope * (r.reset - now_s)}
    })

panels.title: 7-day: projected at reset
panels.description: Where the week ends up if usage continues at its rate over the last 48 hours of this week (since the last weekly reset). 100 or more means you are on course to hit the weekly cap.

  |> reduce(identity: {n: 0, u0: 0.0, t0: 0.0, u1: 0.0, t1: 0.0, reset: 0.0},

                                      u1: r.u7, t1: float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0, reset: r.reset7}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => {

panels.title: Window fill rate vs safe rate
panels.description: How fast the 5-hour window fills, in percentage points per hour (resets excluded). The dashed line is the safe rate: what you could keep using from now and still land on exactly 100% at the reset ((100 - used) / hours left). Above it you will hit the cap before the window resets.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "claude" and r._field == "u5")
  |> derivative(unit: 1h, nonNegative: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0.0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "points per hour"})

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "claude" and (r._field == "u5" or r._field == "reset5"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.u5 and exists r.reset5)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: (100.0 - r.u5) / ((r.reset5 - float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0) / 3600.0), left: (r.reset5 - float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0) / 3600.0}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.left > 1.0)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "safe rate"})

panels.description: Mean 5-hour utilization at each hour of the day over 28 days, weekdays (Mon-Fri) against weekends (Sat-Sun), in the dashboard time zone for America/Denver.

import "date"

option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Denver")

panels.title: Estimated usage by model (last 2 days)
panels.description: Estimated share of the 5-hour budget used in each 10 minutes, by model, from the Claude Code and pi session logs on the machine running the defenestrator (API-equivalent cost x 0.58% per $, measured Oct 2026 on Max). Other devices and claude.ai are not in the logs, so this is a subset of the account-wide utilization above.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_use" and r._field == "pct")
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10m, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(column: "_value", value: 0.0)

panels.title: Estimated usage by project, top 8 (last 2 days)
panels.description: Same estimate (per 10 minutes), by project (the session directory; worktrees count toward their project). Only the 8 biggest projects in the time range are shown.

targets.query:
import "join"

data = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_use" and r._field == "pct")

top = data
  |> group(columns: ["project"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> top(n: 8, columns: ["_value"])
  |> keep(columns: ["project"])

join.inner(left: data |> group(), right: top, on: (l, r) => l.project == r.project, as: (l, r) => l)
  |> group(columns: ["project"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10m, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(column: "_value", value: 0.0)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "project"])

panels.title: 5-hour windows per 7-day window, sized and coloured by how full each got
panels.description: One bar per 7-day window (by the day it started), stacked from its first 5-hour window (bottom) to its last. Each segment is one 5-hour window, as tall as the share of it you used (a full-height segment ran out) and coloured the same way, pale yellow (barely used) to red (ran out). The bar's height is how many full windows' worth you used that week (plus a thin gap between windows, 0.05 each). Hover a segment for its window.

targets.query:
import "array"
import "date"
import "internal/debug"

windows = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "claude" and (r._field == "u5" or r._field == "reset5" or r._field == "reset7"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.u5 and exists r.reset5 and exists r.reset7)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with win: int(v: r.reset5 / 600.0 + 0.5)}))
  |> group(columns: ["win"])
  |> max(column: "u5")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: 1, win: r.win, peak: r.u5, wreset: r.reset5, week: int(v: r.reset7 / 43200.0 + 0.5)}))

starters = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1y)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_event" and r.provider == "claude" and (r.kind == "ping" or r.kind == "started" or r.kind == "started-elsewhere") and (r._field == "reset" or r._field == "reason"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "kind"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.reset)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: 1, sreset: r.reset, skind: r.kind, detail: if exists r.reason then r.reason else ""}))

withStarters = union(tables: [starters, array.from(rows: [{k: 1, sreset: 0.0, skind: "none", detail: ""}])])

matched = join(tables: {w: windows, p: withStarters}, on: ["k"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: r.k, win: r.win, peak: r.peak, wreset: r.wreset, week: r.week, hit: if r.sreset > 0.0 and r.sreset - r.wreset < 1800.0 and r.wreset - r.sreset < 1800.0 then 1 else 0, skind: r.skind, detail: r.detail}))
  |> group(columns: ["win"])
  |> max(column: "hit")
  |> group()

// who started each window: defenestrator (a ping matches), you (a first message was found in the
// session logs), elsewhere (no message in this host's logs), or unknown (not described)
classified = matched
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({win: r.win, peak: r.peak, week: r.week, start: r.wreset - 18000.0, detail: r.detail,
      who: if r.hit == 0 then "unknown" else if r.skind == "ping" then "defenestrator" else if r.skind == "started" then "you" else "elsewhere"}))

slots = classified
  |> group(columns: ["week"])
  |> sort(columns: ["start"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with n: 1}))
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["n"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      day = date.truncate(t: time(v: (r.week * 43200 - 604800) * 1000000000), unit: 1d)
      names = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]
      return {week: r.week, label: "from " + names[date.weekDay(t: day)] + " " + string(v: date.month(t: day)) + "/" + string(v: date.monthDay(t: day)),
        slot: (if r.n < 10 then "0" else "") + string(v: r.n), full: r.peak / 100.0}
    })
  |> group()

// a thin transparent gap after each window, so neighbouring full windows stay apart
union(tables: [slots, slots |> map(fn: (r) => ({week: r.week, label: r.label, slot: r.slot + " gap", full: 0.05}))])
  |> sort(columns: ["slot"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["week", "label"], columnKey: ["slot"], valueColumn: "full")
  |> sort(columns: ["week"])
  |> drop(columns: ["week"])

panels.title: How full each 5-hour window got
panels.description: One bar per 5-hour window, placed where it started, as tall as the highest 5-hour utilization reached in it (a bar at 100 ran out). Colour is what started the window: orange the defenestrator, blue your own first message (found in this host's session logs: the tool, session, project and model are in the line's hover text and the table below), purple a message that is not in this host's logs (another machine, the app or the web), grey from before events were logged. Hover a dashed line on this or the charts above for the details.

import "array"
import "date"
import "internal/debug"

windows = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "claude" and (r._field == "u5" or r._field == "reset5" or r._field == "reset7"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.u5 and exists r.reset5 and exists r.reset7)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with win: int(v: r.reset5 / 600.0 + 0.5)}))
  |> group(columns: ["win"])
  |> max(column: "u5")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: 1, win: r.win, peak: r.u5, wreset: r.reset5, week: int(v: r.reset7 / 43200.0 + 0.5)}))

starters = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1y)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_event" and r.provider == "claude" and (r.kind == "ping" or r.kind == "started" or r.kind == "started-elsewhere") and (r._field == "reset" or r._field == "reason"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "kind"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.reset)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: 1, sreset: r.reset, skind: r.kind, detail: if exists r.reason then r.reason else ""}))

withStarters = union(tables: [starters, array.from(rows: [{k: 1, sreset: 0.0, skind: "none", detail: ""}])])

matched = join(tables: {w: windows, p: withStarters}, on: ["k"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: r.k, win: r.win, peak: r.peak, wreset: r.wreset, week: r.week, hit: if r.sreset > 0.0 and r.sreset - r.wreset < 1800.0 and r.wreset - r.sreset < 1800.0 then 1 else 0, skind: r.skind, detail: r.detail}))
  |> group(columns: ["win"])
  |> max(column: "hit")
  |> group()

// who started each window: defenestrator (a ping matches), you (a first message was found in the
// session logs), elsewhere (no message in this host's logs), or unknown (not described)
classified = matched
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({win: r.win, peak: r.peak, week: r.week, start: r.wreset - 18000.0, detail: r.detail,
      who: if r.hit == 0 then "unknown" else if r.skind == "ping" then "defenestrator" else if r.skind == "started" then "you" else "elsewhere"}))

classified
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: time(v: int(v: r.start) * 1000000000), "started by": if r.who == "unknown" then "unknown (before logging)" else r.who,
      detail: if r.who == "defenestrator" then (if r.detail == "" then "defenestrator primer ping" else r.detail) else r.detail, "peak %": r.peak}))
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

import "array"
import "date"
import "internal/debug"

windows = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_usage" and r.provider == "claude" and (r._field == "u5" or r._field == "reset5" or r._field == "reset7"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.u5 and exists r.reset5 and exists r.reset7)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with win: int(v: r.reset5 / 600.0 + 0.5)}))
  |> group(columns: ["win"])
  |> max(column: "u5")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: 1, win: r.win, peak: r.u5, wreset: r.reset5, week: int(v: r.reset7 / 43200.0 + 0.5)}))

starters = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1y)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "defenestrator_event" and r.provider == "claude" and (r.kind == "ping" or r.kind == "started" or r.kind == "started-elsewhere") and (r._field == "reset" or r._field == "reason"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "kind"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.reset)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: 1, sreset: r.reset, skind: r.kind, detail: if exists r.reason then r.reason else ""}))

withStarters = union(tables: [starters, array.from(rows: [{k: 1, sreset: 0.0, skind: "none", detail: ""}])])

matched = join(tables: {w: windows, p: withStarters}, on: ["k"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: r.k, win: r.win, peak: r.peak, wreset: r.wreset, week: r.week, hit: if r.sreset > 0.0 and r.sreset - r.wreset < 1800.0 and r.wreset - r.sreset < 1800.0 then 1 else 0, skind: r.skind, detail: r.detail}))
  |> group(columns: ["win"])
  |> max(column: "hit")
  |> group()

// who started each window: defenestrator (a ping matches), you (a first message was found in the
// session logs), elsewhere (no message in this host's logs), or unknown (not described)
classified = matched
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({win: r.win, peak: r.peak, week: r.week, start: r.wreset - 18000.0, detail: r.detail,
      who: if r.hit == 0 then "unknown" else if r.skind == "ping" then "defenestrator" else if r.skind == "started" then "you" else "elsewhere"}))

afterPing = join(tables: {w: windows, p: starters |> filter(fn: (r) => r.skind == "ping")}, on: ["k"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({win: r.win, sreset: r.sreset, gap: (r.wreset - 18000.0) - r.sreset}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.gap > -600.0 and r.gap < 43200.0)
  |> group(columns: ["sreset"])
  |> min(column: "gap")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({win: r.win, after: 1}))

grouped = join(tables: {c: classified, a: union(tables: [afterPing, classified |> map(fn: (r) => ({win: r.win, after: 0}))]) |> group(columns: ["win"]) |> max(column: "after") |> group()}, on: ["win"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with grp: if r.who == "defenestrator" then "started by defenestrator" else if r.after == 1 then "right after a defenestrator window" else "other windows"}))

counted = grouped
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({grp: r.grp, bucket: if r.peak >= 99.5 then 100 else if r.peak >= 90.0 then 90 else int(v: r.peak / 10.0) * 10, n: 1}))

totals = counted |> group(columns: ["grp"]) |> sum(column: "n") |> group() |> map(fn: (r) => ({grp: r.grp, total: r.n}))

zeros = array.from(rows: [
  {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 0}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 10}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 20}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 30}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 40}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 50}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 60}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 70}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 80}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 90}, {grp: "started by defenestrator", bucket: 100},
  {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 0}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 10}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 20}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 30}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 40}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 50}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 60}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 70}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 80}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 90}, {grp: "right after a defenestrator window", bucket: 100},
  {grp: "other windows", bucket: 0}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 10}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 20}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 30}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 40}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 50}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 60}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 70}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 80}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 90}, {grp: "other windows", bucket: 100}])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with n: 0}))

summed = union(tables: [counted, zeros])
  |> group(columns: ["grp", "bucket"])
  |> sum(column: "n")
  |> group()

shares = join(tables: {a: summed, b: totals}, on: ["grp"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({grp: r.grp + " (" + string(v: r.total) + ")", bucket: r.bucket, share: 100.0 * float(v: r.n) / float(v: r.total)}))

union(tables: [shares, shares |> filter(fn: (r) => r.bucket == 100) |> map(fn: (r) => ({grp: r.grp, bucket: 110, share: r.share}))])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["bucket"], columnKey: ["grp"], valueColumn: "share")
  |> sort(columns: ["bucket"])
